Minsara Kanavu is a 1997 Tamil film written and directed by Rajiv Menon. Minsara Kanavu songs are composed by A.R.Rahman. Minsara Kanavu stars Arvind Swamy, Prabhu Deva and Kajol in the lead roles while Girish Karnad, S.P.Balasubrahmanyam and Nassar play other pivotal roles.
